Title: Generally Available: SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines in Azure Bleu
Services: SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines

Body.Content:
SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines is now available in Azure Bleu, enabling you to deploy and manage SQL Server workloads in France's sovereign cloud environment while meeting data residency and sovereignty requirements. 

 Learn more.
